svg.text: Time and attendance: the target-state service blueprint
Seven lifecycle stages across four lanes, with the eight failure points the research located. Cells show
the target state the Top-10 was scored against; notes name the fix or the constraint.
KFC South Pacific, 2024. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the engagement's blueprint; vendor, sites and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
